additional_info.subject: RE: Automatic reply: ID0421262-DC/Si-D/BE-[MP / R5 170001829]Commisioning issue CRM:02698000074
additional_info.body:
Hello Erik,
As discussed with Bas
Jeurissen, below are the summary points for the task done on 22/04/25:
Issue: Charger was not connected to OCPP backend, charger was on old f.w version.
Work done in charger;
1) Charger f.w uprated from V2.11.0 to V4.0.11 step by step.
2) Charger was commissioned previously.
3) The OCPP information was update in Charger.
4) Charger comes back online after software update to V4.0.11
5) When Tried to update the Charger form V4.0.11 to V5.0.23 VIA OTA it got stuck.
6
) Charger again comes back online to F.W V4.0.11
Task to be performed:
1)No charging session is performed with the charger & charger is kept in warehouse now
2) Need to update the charger to latest f.W Version.
3) Charging session needs to be tested & observe the charger.
3) CFast flash & Live Linux are optional steps( if required then need to be performed)
Note: No service or commissioning report available for the charger.
P
lease confirm when next site visit can be planned as the charger is still in ware house.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Sunil Sharma
